structured_output.what_is_happening: "Orvix Agent" (B3ZJ…pump) is a 15-minute-old pump.fun coin at about $34-36k market cap, still on the bonding curve (95/115 virtual SOL). It has 287 unique buyers and about $33k of volume. At almost the same moment, a same-name token (Pj2Po…pump) created 5 minutes after this one has already migrated to PumpSwap and sits at about $2.1M market cap with $132k liquidity (+4,050%). This coin looks like a cheaper same-name side bet that is catching overflow from that runner. This one does carry the orvixagent.fun website and x.com/orvixagent links on DexScreener. The website is actually a Solana status/Agave release tracker, which does not match the "decentralized AI computer network" description.

narrative.description: A generic 'AI agent / decentralized AI compute' meme. The name gets heat from a same-name coin that reached $2.1M within minutes. I found no external event, news or X discussion.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely overflow from the Pj2Po Orvix Agent token's run to $2.1M: traders buy the cheaper 'OG/first-created' same-name coin. There is no organic narrative source.

token_connection.why_this_token: It was created about 5 minutes before the $2.1M version and has the website and X links on its DexScreener profile, so it can claim to be 'the OG with socials'. But the market has clearly picked Pj2Po as the main coin.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Pj2Po1d29jqwZvkjPAMybiMJHDUWKzVcW8gLhJUpump: $2.1M market cap, $132k liquidity, migrated, the dominant one. Also 7+ other ORVIX clones at about $3k, all dead.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN reports a bot/degen rate of 0.58, rat-trader share among top traders of 62%, entrapment share of 62%, and 23 bundler wallets. The creator has launched 25 tokens (best ATH about $194k) and the dev's X account has launched 11. There are no smart-money or KOL wallets and no paid boosts. Top-10 holders own only 14.7% (excluding the curve) and are spread fairly evenly at about 1.45% each, which could itself point to bundled evenly sized buys.
authenticity.uncertainty: I couldn't read X, and I couldn't confirm which coin, if either, the orvixagent account endorses.

structural_risks: The top-10 holders all hold about 1.45-1.48%, which looks like a bundle
The same-name $2.1M coin takes most of the attention; if it dumps, this one follows
About 20 more SOL is needed to complete the curve; migration can bring a sell-off

structured_output.counterargument: When a same-name coin runs to $2M+, the cheaper, older sibling with socials sometimes gets a strong catch-up bid ('the real OG'). At a $35k market cap, a 2x to $70k only needs curve completion plus a small migration pump, which is easy while the other coin is this hot.
unknowns: Whether x.com/orvixagent posts this contract address or the Pj2Po one
Why Pj2Po ran (a KOL or dev call?)
Whether the evenly sized top holders are one bundle

source_coverage.notes: I ran general web searches for the name, the ticker and both contract addresses and found nothing about the token. The website is a Solana status tracker that does not match the token's description. DexScreener was checked for both tokens. Reddit, Telegram and Discord were not searched separately because of the time limit.

structured_output.thesis: A cheap same-name side bet on a sibling that just ran to $2.1M, from a serial deployer, with bundle-like holder distribution and heavy rat-trader activity. There is some chance of a catch-up pump through migration, but spillover coins usually fade once the main coin cools.
